title: Hot Jordanian Lamb Mansaf
description: A spicy, pillowy lamb dish infused with yellow curry paste, steam cooked to tenderness and finished with a subtle salt-bake for a golden crust. Low-carb and flavorful, it is served hot from a bamboo steamer for a traditional Middle Eastern experience.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sear the lamb cubes until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a mixing bowl and add yellow curry paste, cumin, paprika, dried mint, salt, and yogurt; stir until the lamb is fully coated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Arrange the marinated lamb in the bottom of a bamboo steamer, place a layer of toasted almonds on top, and pour 300ml water into the steamer tray.
Steam the lamb over high heat for 25 minutes until tender.
Remove the steamer, add lemon juice, stir, and transfer the lamb mixture to a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes to develop a golden crust.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh coriander leaves, and accompany with a side of low-carb salad.
